description: Fix partial-close INSERT storing wrong tokens_held and remove dead usd_sign variable
steps: Capture sold_tokens = pos['tokens_held'] * TAKE_PROFIT_SELL_FRACTION BEFORE reducing pos['tokens_held'] to 20%
Pass sold_tokens instead of pos['tokens_held'] to the partial_closed INSERT statement
Remove the dead usd_sign variable from get_portfolio_summary()
acceptance_criteria: The partial_closed DB row stores the sold 80% token count, not the remaining 20%
No dead code (usd_sign) in portfolio summary
findings: All 595 tests pass. The fix ensures analytics queries computing average exit price as amount_usd / tokens_held from partial_closed rows get correct values instead of 4x inflated values.
